reviewer: AI (Claude) independent reviewers (blind solve + informed review), separate from the author; not a native-speaker or teacher review

patches.why: Word order of coordinated adjectives (warm and quiet / quiet and warm) is not unique, so the ordering question has two correct answers.

bad: First, the eggs mix and the flour.
First, mix the eggs the and flour.
First, mix and the eggs the flour.

patches.why: Original bad[1] and bad[2] are defensible English; replaced with clearly ungrammatical sentences (good, cz and rule unchanged).

bad: The boy opened careful the door.
The boy carefully the door opened.
The carefully boy opened the door.

patches.why: Blind solver found "opened carefully the door" defensible (adverb between verb and short object); replaced with an unambiguous error.

criteria: single defensible answer (blind solve), natural English, level, distractor validity, hint and explanation
